name: Houston County, AL
findings: Houston County has 289 nonprofit organizations. 106 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 83 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Houston County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 16 religious organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 7 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 16 organizations here; 36% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do religious organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 35 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
